faq.a: Taslima is associated with the Arabic form تَسْلِيمَة, whose core sense is taslima; submission, greeting.

faq.q: What is the origin of Taslima?
faq.a: Taslima is associated with Arabic. Taslima is Arabic تَسْلِيمَة (Taslīma), from تَسْلِيم, meaning 'submission, greeting'.
Yes — the underlying form تَسْلِيمَة is Arabic.
Taslima can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Taslima should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Taslīm is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Taslima mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Taslima is rendered تسلیمہ and carries the sense تسلیمہ، سلام.

faq.q: What does Taslima mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Taslima is rendered تسلیمه and carries the sense تسلیمه، تسلیم.
A romanized syllable approximation is tas-li-ma. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Taslima?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Taslima, taslima. Script forms are تسليمه, تسلیمه, تسلیمہ, تَسْلِيمَة, तस्लीमा.

faq.q: Is Taslima a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
